title: Senator Reid: they're shutting down our nukes

tellings.quote: immediately without a pause he goes the fact that they're shutting down our nukes basically

plain: Around 2019, Harry Reid, the former Senate leader, is said to have answered at once, when asked what worried him most about UFOs, that "they're shutting down our nukes". James Fox, a filmmaker who investigates UFOs, says he asked Reid the question himself and Reid replied without a pause. Fox links it to the work of the researcher Robert Hastings, who collected reports of UFOs disabling nuclear missiles.
